snippet.title: GTA Online: A Safehouse in the Hills Coming This December
snippet.description:
You’ve already built an empire. Now let Prix Luxury Real Estate erect your palace. Own the extravagant residence of your dreams in GTA Online: A Safehouse in the Hills, coming this December.

The preeminent purveyors of luxury listings are breaking ground on a series of new property developments in some of Los Santos' most exclusive neighborhoods. These meticulously designed estates will feature sprawling grounds, breathtaking views, and first-rate amenities — including the latest in personal assistance and business service technology.
